idea_taken: Recursively order JSON object members of the template-bound tool copy so equivalent client schemas render the same prompt prefix; keep array order.
modifications: Applied once in validate_request, so the rendered prompt and the strict-tool grammar (resolve_local_refs + compile_constraint) see the same object; omlx orders only its template copy.

A properties map lists its sibling required names first, then optional names, each group sorted. Plain alphabetical order (omlx) can put an optional property before a required one, and the mlx2 constrained-output compiler rejects that ordering.
Tool and function wrappers keep the conventional type,function / name,description,parameters lead; other members are sorted.

Every object member is sorted, including non-schema values (default, examples, vendor extensions). omlx also fills a description on every schema node; mlx2 does not (only the existing function-level description default).
